why: The pilot, 2026-10-22: the main win con is 21 commander damage from EITHER commander, chosen by the board. Branched off finisher-v1 (which lost to the deck at olivers-table, 33/297 vs 45/299, by cutting the draw/discard/burn engine). Shabraz is primary: a flier with a counter per draw, Lae'zel and Yoshimaru add one each, Teferi's Ageless Insight, Bard and the Archive double the draws. Brallin is secondary: Torbran +2 and Gratuitous Violence double his combat damage, with double strike and trample. Each line has a backup and a tutor (Idyllic Tutor, Stoneforge Mystic). Khorvath's Fury back; wheels down to four; one-sided sweepers for the go-wide table; red-capable rocks. Argued by the strategist (frame and one adversarial pass), card-scout (three passes), rules-question (Torbran and doubled damage count as Brallin's commander damage; Lae'zel makes a 7-card wheel 14 counters).

commits.message: sharknado voltron-v1 mana pass: five land swaps toward red (Glacial Fortress->Battlefield Forge, Irrigated Farmland->Inspiring Vantage, Island->Mountain, Sea of Clouds->Needleverge Pathway, Temple of Epiphany->Mountain); land sources R 28->32, U 30->25, W 19; on curve lands-only R 0.785->0.855; always tapped 7->5. 300/arm A/B stopped before look 1 on the pilot's word for this pass
wheel slots: Ashling's Command->Tolarian Winds, Coldsteel Heart->Reforge the Soul, Commander's Sphere->Jace's Archivist, Shark Typhoon->Glint-Horn Buccaneer (Brallin's discard line back)
mana: Floodfarm Verge->Sunbillow Verge, Hallowed Fountain->Clifftop Retreat

summary.title: Modal voltron: either shark hits for twenty-one, Brallin's wheels burn the table
summary.blurb: Wins by commander damage from whichever partner the board favours, with equipment, double strike and protection behind them; Brallin's discard wheels with Torbran burn the whole table and grow him for the swing; the mana leans red under the red-heavy payoffs.

staged.why: Forge 2.0.14 has no script for Yoshimaru; Fiery Emancipation triples damage from any source we control, a backup for both commander lines
Forge's AI held Temur Battle Rage castable on 8 turns and never cast it; Fireshrieker is double strike the AI equips
Forge's AI held Bulk Up castable on 9 turns and never cast it; Genji Glove is double strike plus an extra combat
both-out pass: double strike for every attacker, so both commanders at once, in place of one target
both-out pass: a two-mana repeatable loot; each loot is a counter on both commanders and a ping to each opponent
both-out pass: an instant-speed loot on every player's turn, in place of symmetric draw that fed only Shabraz and the table
both-out pass: draw two discard two untap three lands; held and discarded four times in the 40 games
both-out pass: a repeatable loot whose Treasure pays the {R} trample or {W/U} flying activation
both-out pass: a second combat for both commanders; Boots' hexproof does nothing against edicts and Greaves already gives haste
both-out pass: creatures get +X/+X for cards drawn this turn, a wheel turn makes both commanders lethal; the tenth rock was surplus

the extra combat as a trigger: whenever you attack, untap the attackers, first strike, another combat; the AI held Relentless Assault castable 22 turns and never cast it (UntapAllAi plays it only after combat with a tapped attacker)
